name: Sineng Electric Co.,Ltd.
summary: Sineng Electric Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of power electronic equipment in the People's Republic of China, Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, and internationally. It offers photovoltaic (PV) inverters, such as residential, string, and central inverters; energy storage systems, which include hybrid inverters and batteries, string power conversion systems, and central power conversion systems; smart power quality controllers, active power filters, static var generators, and intelligent power quality correction devices; and monitoring products and accessories.
